useCase: Detecting geometric 不整合 and impossible 遠近法s in AI生成の architectural/scene images
mechanism: 検出します straight lines using Hough Transform and estimates vanishing points from line intersections. 検証します geometric consistency by checking that parallel lines in 3D converge to consistent vanishing points. AI生成の scenes often violate projective geometry rules, creating physically impossible 遠近法s.
